games.title: CRASH
games.pitch: dodge the tasks, drink the coffee, don't get cooked.
how_to: tasks fall. touching one = +15° heat. big ones hurt more.
coffee −11°, fans −24°.
heat creeps up on its own. it gets worse. like real life.
score = time alive + dodges + pickups.

games.title: Handbag Havoc
games.pitch: granny on a mobility scooter bowls garden gnomes into each other with her purse. it's self-defence.
games.controls: wasd / arrows or drag anywhere to steer. turn hard to power up the purse. 1 2 3 picks upgrades. r restart, p pause, m mute.

games.title: only 1% can close this pop-up
games.pitch: 30 fake pop-ups, 5 seconds each. the x runs away. so will your confidence.
games.controls: tap / click to close, drag where it says drag. enter or space starts and retries, m mutes.

games.title: +1 Speed Keyboard Escape
games.pitch: every key is +1 speed. esc is further than you think.
games.controls: tap, click or space to jump (hold for a longer jump). crash runs by himself. land dead centre for perfect bonuses. p pause, r back to boot (keeps speed), m mute.

games.title: desktop jam
games.pitch: tap your desktop icons until they leave. final_FINAL_v3.docx is in the way. it always is.
games.controls: tap or click an icon to slide it off in its arrow's direction. keyboard: arrows move the cursor, enter/space taps, r restarts, p pauses, m mutes.

games.title: fathom
games.pitch: submarine duel against a computer with opinions. every miss tells you how close you were. decoys lie.
games.controls: tap or click the enemy sea to fire. arrow keys + enter also fire, s toggles sonar. drag subs to move, tap to rotate. modes: classic or salvo.

games.title: tab hoarder
games.pitch: stack browser tabs on a tired computer. perfect drops stack a multiplier. free_ram_download.exe is a trap.
games.controls: tap / click / space to drop. m mutes, p pauses, s shares on the result card.

games.title: crash test (daily)
games.pitch: a new sliding puzzle every day, the same for everyone. get the hot air out of crash in as few moves as possible, then flex your 🟩🟨🟥 grid.
games.controls: drag parts · tab + arrows · u undo · r restart

games.title: bellchain
games.pitch: an idle game that plays actual music. buy a cowbell. then 200 more.
games.controls: tap or click anywhere to ring (space works too). buy bells and upgrades in the panel. m mutes.

games.title: level devil.exe
games.pitch: a troll platformer where the floor, the exit, the cursor and the taskbar all want you dead. 36 levels, a blue screen every death, infinite retries.
games.controls: ←→ / a d move · ↑ / w / space jump · r restart · esc levels · touch buttons on mobile
how_to: every level is a file that lies. if a floor, an exit or a checkpoint looks too easy, it probably is.
keep moving on stairs and bridges: some of them delete themselves behind you.
the controls can get swapped mid-level. watch which way you actually move, not which key you pressed.
deaths are free. r restarts the level instantly, esc opens the level list.
new speedrun starts from level 1 and times the whole run, deaths included.

games.title: pixel purge
games.pitch: crash's pictures got corrupted. load floppy-disk turrets onto a 5-slot bench and shoot every pixel back into place. fill the bench and you're cooked.
games.controls: tap / click a floppy (keys 1-3), z = ctrl+z, r = restart. badges show how many pixels each front disk can hit.
how_to: tap a floppy with a number badge: it shoots the lowest pixel of its color in each column, so clear from the bottom up.
the badge is how many pixels that front disk can hit right now. sleepy disks have nothing to shoot yet.
empty disks leave. anything with shots left sits on the 5-slot bench, and a full bench means you are cooked.
z is ctrl+z: one undo per level. save it for when the bench is nearly full.
the daily picture is the same for everyone, and only your first try counts.

games.title: crash cheats at tic tac toe
games.pitch: beat crash at tic tac toe. he deletes your x's, fakes lag, spills coffee and blue-screens when he's losing. good luck.
games.controls: tap / click a square · keys 1–9 or arrows + space · q firewall, w ctrl+z, e report (costs a token)

games.title: overdue notice
games.pitch: smash popups and piggy banks for cash, pay rent and wi-fi before the late fees stack up, and keep the debt collector out. an incremental about being broke.
games.controls: tap / click popups and bills · space smashes (fast taps build a combo) · p pays all · g takes a gig · 1–4 tabs · 1/2 pick the daily situation

games.title: +1 ram every second
games.pitch: you gain +1 mb every second. eat smaller processes. run from bigger ones. become the kernel.
games.controls: drag anywhere to steer (mouse or wasd/arrows on desktop). p pauses, m mutes.

games.title: smol brains
games.pitch: an island of tiny pixel creatures with real neural-network brains. they crash-land, evolve, invent fire, build villages and pray to you. they will learn the wrong things.
games.controls: drag to pan, pinch or wheel to zoom, twist or right-drag to rotate, slide two fingers (or r/v) to tilt, tap or drag the map to jump. tools: grab (carry, throw, shake trees), tickle (reward), tap (scold), talk (the word book), magic (miracles), orders. possess a smol from its card: wasd + mouse, e/f/r act, c make, esc leave. wasd pan, q/e rotate, 1-6 tools, space pause, [ ] speed, b brain viewer, m map.
how_to: tap the crashed pod open. two blobs climb out, a girl and a boy: the last smols. name them.
💬 talk opens the word book. pick a word, then show it: tap some food for “food”, or ask a smol to “come” and it learns when it does. one lesson every few seconds, so mashing does nothing.
tickle right after the good thing. a few seconds late rewards whatever it is doing by then, which is how smols learn weird superstitions.
smols remember who hit them, shared food, or taught them things. tap a smol → 📜 story to see its friends, rivals and life so far; the menu's 📜 chronicle keeps the island's history.
family can't have kids together. welcome strangers from the other escape pods, or your tribe runs out of futures.
miracles get pricier the more you lean on them, and handouts spoil smols. answer prayers with the right miracle: that's where sparks come from.
the island starts under cloud. smols clear it by exploring, and new places hold new plants, stone, and bunnies to hunt.
a storyteller deals story cards every few minutes: grump raids, storms, sniffles, falling stars, feuds, lost kids, dreams. pick an answer; some cost ✨ sparks.
explore the fog: the "?" marks hide ruins, crystal caves, nests and grump camps holding captured smols.
tap a smol and it holds still for a few seconds, so it's easy to teach. the word book opens at the side of the screen.

the seasons turn every 40 minutes: blossoms, summer storms, falling leaves, snow. the soundtrack, 20 songs, follows them; some only play in one season, at night, or in the rain. settings has a jukebox.
more escape pods crash while you play. you see where on the map: send a rescue party of grown smols, lift them home with magic, or they climb out on their own later.
smols remember places, dream about their day, read each other's moods and pick goals. open the 🧠 brain viewer to hear what one is thinking.
new here? say yes to the tutorial: it stays with you the whole game, with a tip whenever something new happens or you're not sure what to do.
evolve them all the way to ascended and build the big thought. it's a signal home. then try new game+.
